name: CanvasShapes
description: Use the CanvasItems property of either a Shape or ShapeRange object to return a CanvasShapes collection.
remarks: To add shapes to a drawing canvas, use the following methods of the CanvasShapes collection: AddCallout, AddConnector, AddCurve, AddLabel, AddLine, AddPicture, AddPolyline, AddShape, AddTextbox, AddTextEffect, or BuildFreeform. The following example adds a drawing canvas to the active document and then adds three shapes to the drawing canvas. Use CanvasItems (index), where index is the name or the index number, to return a single shape in the CanvasShapes collection. The following example sets the Line and Fill properties and vertically flips the third shape in a drawing canvas. Each shape is assigned a default name when it is created. For example, if you add three different shapes to a document, they might be named Rectangle 2, TextBox 3, and Oval 4. Use the Name property to reference the default name or to assign a more meaningful name to a shape.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CanvasShapes object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of canvas shapes in the specified collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Shape object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: AddCallout
methods.signature: AddCallout(Type As MsoCalloutType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a borderless line callout to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the callout.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of callout.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, in points, of the left edge of the callout's bounding box.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, in points, of the top edge of the callout's bounding box.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the callout's bounding box.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the callout's bounding box.

methods.name: AddConnector
methods.signature: AddConnector(Type As MsoConnectorType, BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents a connecting line between two shapes in a drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of connector.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position that marks the beginning of the connector.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position that marks the beginning of the connector.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position that marks the end of the connector.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position that marks the end of the connector.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents a Bzier curve in a drawing canvas.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the vertices and control points of the curve. The first point you specify is the starting vertex, and the next two points are control points for the first Bzier segment. Then, for each additional segment of the curve, you specify a vertex and two control points. The last point you specify is the ending vertex for the curve. Note that you must always specify 3n + 1 points, where n is the number of segments in the curve.

methods.name: AddLabel
methods.signature: AddLabel(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a text label to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shapes object that represents the text label.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the text.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the label relative to the left edge of the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the label relative to the top edge of the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the label, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the label, in points.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.signature: AddLine(BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a line to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the line and adds it to the CanvasShapes collection.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the line's starting point, relative to the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the line's starting point, relative to the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position, measured in points, of the line's endpoint, relative to the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position, measured in points, of the line's endpoint, relative to the drawing canvas.

methods.name: AddPicture
methods.signature: AddPicture(FileName As String, [LinkToFile As Variant], [SaveWithDocument As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a picture to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the picture and adds it to the CanvasShapes collection.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the picture.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: True to link the picture to the file from which it was created. False to make the picture an independent copy of the file. The default value is False.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: True to save the linked picture with the document. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the new picture relative to the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the new picture relative to the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, in points.

methods.name: AddPolyline
methods.description: Adds an open or closed polygon to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the polygon.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the polyline drawing's vertices.

methods.name: AddShape
methods.signature: AddShape(Type As Long, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds an AutoShape to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the AutoShape.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of shape to be returned. Can be any MsoAutoShape constant.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the AutoShape.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the AutoShape.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, measured in points, of the AutoShape.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, measured in points, of the AutoShape.

methods.name: AddTextEffect
methods.signature: AddTextEffect(PresetTextEffect As MsoPresetTextEffect, Text As String, FontName As String, FontSize As Single, FontBold As MsoTriState, FontItalic As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a WordArt shape to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the WordArt.

parameters.name: PresetTextEffect
parameters.description: A preset text effect. The values of the MsoPresetTextEffect constants correspond to the formats listed in the WordArt Gallery dialog box (numbered from left to right and from top to bottom).

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description: The name of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontSize
parameters.description: The size (in points) of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontBold
parameters.description: msoTrue to bold the WordArt font. msoFalse to set the font used in the WordArt to regular.

parameters.name: FontItalic
parameters.description: msoTrue to italicize the WordArt font. msoFalse to set the font used in the WordArt to regular.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the WordArt shape relative to the left edge of the drawing canvas.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the WordArt shape relative to the top edge of the drawing canvas.

methods.name: AddTextbox
methods.signature: AddTextbox(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a text box to a drawing canvas. Returns a Shape object that represents the text box.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the text. Some of the MsoTextOrientation constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the text box.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the text box.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, measured in points, of the text box.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, measured in points, of the text box.

methods.name: BuildFreeform
methods.signature: BuildFreeform(EditingType As MsoEditingType, X1 As Single, Y1 As Single) As FreeformBuilder
methods.description: Builds a freeform object. Returns a FreeformBuilder object that represents the freeform as it is being built. .

parameters.name: EditingType
parameters.description: The EditingType parameter can be either msoEditingAuto or msoEditingCorner; cannot be msoEditingSmooth or msoEditingSymmetric.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the left edge of the document.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies which shapes are to be included in the specified range. Can be an integer that specifies the index number of a shape within the Shapes collection, a string that specifies the name of a shape, or a array that contains integers or strings.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.description: Selects all the shapes in a canvas.
